# OpenMaison

> The AI operating system for interior design studios.

OpenMaison brings an interior design studio's leads, quotes, projects and finances into one place, with AI that understands renovation work and protects margins. It is built for studios in Singapore.

Built by the team behind Qanvast, Asia's largest interior design platform. Operated by Qanvast Pte. Ltd., Singapore. Founded 2025. Currently pre-launch (early access).

## How the product is organised

The platform is grouped into three pillars, each with dedicated modules:

### Pillar 1 — Clients & Projects
- **Leads** (/site/platform/leads) — Leads from Qanvast, Homereno, Houzz and email arrive automatically, in a pipeline you can read stage by stage, with e-signature.
- **Projects** (/site/platform/projects) — Project plans generated from the approved quote, a Gantt timeline, tasks and approvals, client-portal progress updates, and early warnings when a timeline slips.
- **Meeting Copilot** (/site/platform/meeting-copilot) — A meeting assistant visible only to the designer: it reads the notes you type, with coaching cards, six-dimension deal scoring and a running shadow quote.
- **Maison AI** (/site/platform/maison-ai) — An assistant that reads across leads, projects and finance, takes actions once you confirm, and draws the chart.

### Pillar 2 — Finance
- **Upload a quote** (/site/platform/upload-a-quote) — Turns a quote — a spreadsheet or a PDF — into structured line items in seconds, flags lines that sell below cost or on a thin margin, compares any quote with Quote X-Ray, and routes for approval.
- **Finance & Margins** (/site/platform/finance) — Real-time P&L, per-project margins, commissions, variation-order modelling, milestone invoicing, purchase orders with the vendor's own link, and ten reports (P&L, GST, AR/AP aging, profitability).

### Pillar 3 — Design Meetings
- **AI Visualizer** (/site/platform/visualizer) — Upload a room photo, swap materials and finishes, and generate a life-like render in seconds. Surfaces are detected automatically; renders can be shared to the client portal.
- **3D Space Planner** (/site/platform/space-planner) — Real HDB and condo templates, drag-and-drop furniture with collision detection, and three camera modes for presenting.

## What makes it different

Most interior design software is presentation-first and stops at mood boards and renders. OpenMaison also runs the business: real margins and P&L, AI that takes actions rather than only rendering images, the whole workflow from lead to finance, and a local fit for HDB, condo and Singapore's lead sources.

## Target market

- Interior design studios in Singapore (HDB, condo, landed property)
- Currency and tax: SGD and GST

## Trust & security

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Studios own their data and can export it at any time. Access is role-based per team member. Pricing is not public yet (pre-launch); access is by early-access request.
